statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk 16% sits in the low band while stress stays high at 69%.
recommendation: Tail remains well below the block threshold, so the mapped policy state is EA_ON. The narrow evidence-based danger window runs 12:15Z to 15:00Z, spanning the ADP and August core PCE releases, the US cash open on quarter-end flows, and Chicago PMI. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected.
headline: NQ pinned near its overnight low as a 24-year high in long-end yields meets a dense pre-open data stack
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,523.5, down 0.29%, at the lower edge of a narrow overnight range of 30,516.75 to 30,737.00, after the cash index closed at 30,339.33 on 29 September. The drift lower is shallow and there is no observed repeated extension after failed retracements, so the price path does not currently look pathological. VIX at 16.27 confirms low realised volatility. Stress is instead carried by the rates complex: the 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.62%, its highest since 2002, with the 10-year near 5.26% and the 2-year at 4.92%, while WTI has climbed back above 90 dollars on Middle East supply concerns and core PCE inflation is expected to stay near 3.3% year over year. Consumer confidence fell to its weakest since 2014 and August job openings missed at about 7.08 million. New York Fed President Williams said there is no need for urgency after the September hike, which moved market pricing toward a single further hike in December and pared October odds from roughly 70% to 50%; that reduces near-term policy-shock risk. Congress passed a continuing resolution funding the government through 11 December, so the 1 October fiscal deadline is not a live catalyst. The dense morning stack of ADP, core PCE and Chicago PMI, the quarter-end and month-end cash open, and Micron's fiscal Q4 report after the close are the day's genuine multi-stage checkpoints. Event importance and an unchanged difficult macro backdrop raise stress and shape confidence; they do not by themselves establish the one-way, no-retracement structure that Tail measures.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hours Claude Tail risk fell from 20% to 15% and stress eased from 76% to 66%, as the yellow WATCH readings of the 29 September European and US sessions gave way to a steady green EA_ON run from 20:00Z onward. One hour, 2026-09-29T14:00Z, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. Dominant mode moved from trend-down and trend-up prints during the cash session to normal and then mixed overnight, consistent with orderly two-way trade rather than sustained one-way structure.
outlookSummary: The forecast keeps Tail in the low band for the current hour and lifts it into the 20-22% watch band from 12:00Z to 15:00Z, covering ADP, August core PCE, the quarter-end cash open and Chicago PMI, then eases back to EA_ON through the afternoon on the base case of orderly price discovery. A second, smaller watch-band window at 21:00Z to 22:00Z reflects Micron's fiscal Q4 report and guidance call landing in a thin post-close book, where a semiconductor repricing is the plausible delayed second-leg mechanism. Overnight and into the European morning Tail settles at 16-18% while confidence decays from 88% to 74% as the evidence base ages ahead of the 1 October US data block.
